## Checks before merging
- [ ] The change was reviewed with `/code-review`; findings were fixed or answered below
- [ ] Parsing of downloaded data, SQL, file paths, credentials or workflows changed: `/security-review` done
- [ ] Tests would fail if the change were wrong
- [ ] Migrations are new files, never edits to an applied one
- [ ] No data, secrets or local settings are committed
